existing_local_data.audit_verdict: Unsuitable for production ML training due to lack of ground truth, small sample size, and privacy constraints.

policy_mandate.synthetic_benchmark: Synthetic phone fixtures are used exclusively for pipeline format testing and E.164 normalization checks.
policy_mandate.zero_fake_verdicts: The system will NEVER declare a real telephone subscriber fraudulent based solely on synthetic data.
policy_mandate.transparent_status: When no verified reputation provider is connected, the phone analyzer returns status 'insufficient_data' or 'unavailable'.

supported_features: Country / National Destination Code detection (e.g., Pakistan +92, US +1, UK +44)
Line Type Detection (Mobile, Fixed Line, VoIP, Toll-Free where lawful)
Telecom Carrier Identification (e.g., Jazz, Telenor, Zong, Ufone in Pakistan)
